rationale: Positives: The agent authenticated the user via email lookup, acted only on the user’s own orders, checked order status and product variants, and correctly executed the item swap after obtaining explicit confirmation and noting the price difference. Issues: 1) The agent changed the shipping address on #W5056519 without first stating the exact new address and obtaining explicit confirmation. 2) The agent canceled order #W5995614 without first confirming the cancellation intent. Both are clear violations of the requirement to obtain explicit confirmation before any order-changing write. 3) The agent stated a refund timeline (5–7 business days) not supported by the tools, which risks fabrication of policy details. Due to these confirmation and unsupported-information issues, the conversation fails the pass bar.
